technical.summary: Strong momentum confluence with EMA golden cross, volume spike, and positive CMF, but weak ADX trend strength and conflicting hull MA signal limit conviction for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: MAR shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 20 days—insufficient smart money conviction to support a trade.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (31 Fear/Greed score) with bearish AAII sentiment (48.4%) presents contrarian buying opportunity; congressional activity is stale (120+ days) and mixed with no conviction signal.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (399.84), flat yield curve with recession signals, and recent CPI miss create severely adverse macro conditions for discretionary equities; earnings in 20 days adds execution risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: EMA 9/21 golden cross with 15x volume spike and positive CMF provides strong short-term momentum confluence in an extreme fear environment (31 Fear/Greed) that historically rewards contrarian entries.
debate.key_bear_argument: Macro environment is in crisis (VIX 399.84, flat yield curve, high credit spreads), fundamental conviction is absent (no insider/institutional buying, earnings in 20 days), and technical trend confirmation is weak (ADX false, Hull MA bearish, SMA divergence)—momentum alone cannot overcome systemic headwinds.
